description: Re-measurement of the inductive inter-nucleon operator selection behind prop:nuclear-operator-regimes (Regime I shell rule, withdrawn). Legacy nucleon elements in H3(q), convention D, proton q0, mpmath 80/120 dps. Criteria pre-registered in docs/audits/2026-11-21-nuclear-regime-shell-rule.md §2.
caveats: Nucleon elements are the legacy (σ₀σ₁⁻¹)³·typed-crossing construction of the 2026-04 producer, not γγ-selected; the model is the 2026-04 one, re-run honestly.
The selection LP per step is the vertex-selection LP over the simplex of candidates; its duals are exact and recorded per step under lp_dual.
